title: Buddhist Temporalities (Amendment)
long_title: AN ACT TO AMEND THE BUDDHIST TEMPORALITIES ORDINANCE

edition.caveat: private republisher, not the Government Printer

body.heading: Short title.
body.raw_text: 1. This Act may be cited as the Buddhist Temporalities (Amendment) Act, No 3 of 1992.
body.text: This Act may be cited as the Buddhist Temporalities (Amendment) Act, No 3 of 1992.

body.heading: Amendment of section 2 of Chapter 318.
body.raw_text: 2. Section 2 of the Buddhist Temporalities Ordinance (hereinafter referred to as the "principal enactment") is hereby amended as follows:-

body.heading: Sinhala text to prevail in case of inconsistency .
body.raw_text: 4. In the event of any inconsistency between the Sinhala and Tamil texts of this Act, the Sinhala text shall prevail.
